markers.title: Toggle tap target way too small
markers.body: The unallocated-reservations filter toggle is only ~16×18dp, far below the 44×44dp minimum. Expand the hit area (e.g. include the row's padding) even if the visual switch stays small.

markers.title: Day-selector cells too small to tap
markers.body: Each day column (e.g. "TUE 28") is only about 22×34dp, well under the 44×44dp guideline for the horizontal date strip. Increase the vertical hit area per day or add visible padding around each date.

markers.title: Segmented tabs have a 17dp-tall hit area
markers.body: Check-ins / Check-outs / Stay-throughs tab labels measure only 17dp tall. If the tappable region matches the text bounds it's well under the 44dp minimum — pad the tab buttons vertically.

markers.title: Inconsistent card actions across reservations
markers.body: Alice Foster's card shows plain status text ("Check in · 7 nights") with no button, while Yasmin Ellis's and Fiona King's cards below show live "Take payment" / "Check in" buttons. Staff scanning the list can't predict which cards are actionable — use one consistent pattern (always show the buttons, disabling them when not applicable).

markers.title: Header icon buttons under 44dp
markers.body: The leading and trailing header icons are only about 22×25dp. Increase their padding/hit-slop to reach the 44×44dp touch target minimum, since they sit at the very top edge of the screen.

working_well: Reservation cards use a clear, repeated layout (badge, name, dates, room) that makes scanning the list fast.
Status badges (CONFIRMED, CHECKED IN, CHECKED OUT, UNALLOCATED) pair colour with a text label, so state isn't colour-only.
The active day (FRI 31) is highlighted with both colour and an underline, giving a non-colour cue for the current selection.
worth_considering: Consider bumping the CONFIRMED/CHECKED IN badge text size slightly — at ~13dp it's on the small side for a key status indicator.
Long party names like "The Rodriguez Family" and "The Bennett Family" currently fit, but test even longer names to confirm graceful wrapping/truncation.
Group section headers (Check-ins, Check-outs, Stay-throughs) could show live counts to help staff prioritise without opening each tab.
